periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation angled approximately 45 degrees downward and outward from the medial canthus toward the zygomatic region.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with an elongated vertical axis relative to the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced ventral tapering where the pigment extends significantly below the geometric center toward the maxillary region.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broad U-shaped curvature on the posterior margin across the scapular region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent thick band occupying approximately 25% of the visible dorsal-to-caudal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large inter-pinna gap roughly equal to three times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous convex arc at the superior margin of both ears.
